chapter_title: THE EVER EVOLVING WORLD OF SCIENCE

items.title: Understanding Changes in Materials
items.explanation: Science involves observing how materials behave. Some changes, like ice melting into water or a fruit ripening, can be reversed, while others like rocks breaking into pebbles cannot be undone. These changes are often caused by heat, such as when the sun melts glaciers or evaporates sea water to form rain.

items.title: Exploring Properties of Materials
items.explanation: To understand how things work, we must classify materials based on their properties. This includes testing materials with batteries and wires to discover different types of properties, leading us to explore metals and non-metals.

items.title: Measuring Time and Observing Light
items.explanation: Before electric clocks, humans measured time using shadows from the sun. While light helps us see, asking questions about its nature has given us a deep understanding of the universe.
